name: The Prince and Her River
source:
The story about a young prince, who ran away from royal festivities to not only escape his father and the facades of allies, but also himself, and who the world wishes him to be.

[From [url=https://rainch.itch.io/the-prince-and-her-river]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于一位年轻王子的故事，他逃离了皇家庆典，不仅是为了逃避他的父亲和盟友的外表，也是为了逃避他自己，以及世界希望他成为的人。

[来自[url=https://rainch.itch.io/the-prince-and-her-river]itch.io[/url]]
